<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 114.06808. This matches the exact monoisotopic mass of C₆H₁₀O₂ (6 × 12.0000 + 10 × 1.007825 + 2 × 15.994915 = 114.06808 Da). The isotopic pattern (+1 peak ≈ 6.7 % intensity) is consistent with a molecule containing six carbon atoms. Therefore the molecular formula is C6H10O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H10O2</final_answer>
